MediaRemote Adapter: https://github.com/ungive/mediaremote-adapter
Swift-compatible C sources and run.pl from https://github.com/ejbills/mediaremote-adapter, revision 5b6afde3f501a3da567e23bf7f23d562938a1809. BSD 3-Clause. Isla builds only its Objective-C library and uses read-only get; no Swift wrapper or control commands.
